o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish اَوْ (ev), from Proto-Turkic *eb. Cognate with Old Turkic 𐰋 (eb), Turkish ev.
From Proto-Turkic *yüŕük, a derivation from Proto-Turkic *yüŕ-, whence also Azerbaijani üzəngi (“stirrup”). Cognate with Turkish yüzük, etc.
Borrowed from Classical Persian انگلیس (ing(i)līs), from Italian ingeles, from Old French engleis. Compare Turkish İngiliz, Ottoman Turkish انگلیز (İngiliz).
